prompt: Write a method that tests whether a string is a palindrome, ignoring case and any non-letter characters. Complete the isPalindrome method in the starter file, then run the tests.
explanation: The problem splits into two stages: normalize, then compare. A StringBuilder collects only the letters, lowercased via Character.toLowerCase, so punctuation and spaces never interfere. The two-pointer technique then walks one index in from each end, and any mismatch proves the string is not a palindrome; if the pointers meet without a mismatch (including the empty case), it is one.
hints: First build a cleaned string: loop over s, keep only characters where Character.isLetter(c) is true, and lowercase them.
A StringBuilder with append is a convenient way to collect the kept characters.
Compare with two indexes, one starting at each end of the cleaned string, moving toward the middle until they cross.
